description: A terminal workbench in pure Rust: shells, persistent sessions, SSH and coding agents (nightly)
notes: Nightly pre-release built from the main branch: expect rough edges. The rolling 'nightly' release tag replaces its assets every night, so the version string changes with each build.

The vendor's portable ZIP is used as-is. tty7 only runs in portable mode when it finds both the bundled '.tty7-portable' marker and a 'data' directory next to the executable; Scoop's persisted 'tty7-desktop-nightly' data folder supplies the second half, keeping the nightly profile separate from the stable 'tty7-desktop' app. If that folder is deleted, tty7 silently falls back to '%APPDATA%\tty7'.
The bundled 'tty7-updater.exe' is removed during install, so the app cannot update or replace itself; update with 'scoop update tty7-desktop-nightly'.
tty7 never adds a run-at-login entry: there is no autostart code path in the binary, and the Settings entry called 'Startup & restore' only controls session restore, not Windows startup.

tty7 drops its own 'tty7' shortcut into the Start Menu the first time it runs, outside Scoop's control. 'scoop uninstall' deletes it together with any other shortcut that points into the Scoop directory, so no entry is left behind. Because both channels use that one name, the nightly shortcut is only removed when it points at the nightly install.
Run 'tty7-nightly' for the CLI and 'tty7-app-nightly' for the GUI, so both channels can be installed side by side.
